trick: Show an example instead of describing the style
source_note: Anthropic's prompting docs: use examples. Both sides get the same style rule (JSDoc with a summary, an @param per parameter and an @returns on every function added or changed); with shows it as one unrelated example function, without says it in one sentence. check_style.py scores the touched functions.

with.label: Style shown as an example

without.label: Style described in a sentence
without.prompt_prefix: Code style for this task: above every function you add or change, write a JSDoc block with a one-sentence summary, an @param line for each parameter and an @returns line.
